fullPassage: Spending time as children allows animals to learn about their environment. Without childhood, animals must rely more fully on hardware, and therefore be less flexible. Among migratory bird species, those that are born knowing how, when, and where to migrate — those that are migrating entirely with instructions they were born with — sometimes have very inefficient migration routes. These birds, born knowing how to migrate, don’t adapt easily. So when lakes dry up, forest becomes farmland, or climate change pushes breeding grounds farther north, those birds that are born knowing how to migrate keep flying by the old rules and maps. By comparison, birds with the longest childhoods, and those that migrate with their parents, tend to have the most efficient migration routes. Childhood facilitates the passing on of cultural information, and culture can evolve faster than genes. Childhood gives flexibility in a changing world.

❌ ③ deepest(가장 깊은): 깊이에 관한 것으로 다른 의미축
❌ ④ largest(가장 큰): 크기에 관한 것으로 길이의 반의어가 아님
det.tip: the longest childhoods(가장 긴 유년기) ↔ shortest(가장 짧은)

questions.passage:
(A) Every game has its own <u>rules</u>, and players must follow them carefully to win fairly.
(B) The wise old queen <u>rules</u> the kingdom with kindness, and her people trust her deeply.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 rules의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: rules: (A) 규칙 (게임의 규칙, 명사) / (B) 통치하다 (여왕이 왕국을 다스리다, 동사)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 통치하다 — (B) 규칙: (A)는 게임의 '규칙'(명사), (B)는 '통치하다'(동사)라 뒤바뀜
❌ ② (A) 규칙 — (B) 규칙: (B)는 여왕이 왕국을 '통치하다'라는 동사
✅ ③ (A) 규칙 — (B) 통치하다: (A) its own rules는 명사 '규칙', (B) rules the kingdom은 동사 '통치하다' ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 통치하다 — (B) 통치하다: (A)는 명사 '규칙'
det.tip: rules: ① (명사) 규칙 ② (동사) 통치하다 — 본문 the old rules는 ① 규칙

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to change your behavior so that it becomes easier to live in a new or different situation"

det.korean: adapt=적응하다 (새로운 상황에서 더 잘 살아가도록 행동을 바꾸다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① migrate(이동하다): 장소를 옮기는 것으로 정의와 다름
❌ ② evolve(진화하다): 오랜 시간에 걸친 종의 변화로 정의와 다름
❌ ③ facilitate(촉진하다): 어떤 일을 쉽게 만드는 것으로 정의와 다름
✅ ④ adapt: '새로운 상황에서 더 잘 살도록 행동을 바꾸다'라는 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: These birds ... don’t adapt easily — 적응하다(adapt)

questions.passage: By comparison, birds with the __________ (long) childhoods, and those that migrate with their parents, tend to have the most efficient migration routes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어(long)를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: the __(long) childhoods → 정관사 the와 '가장 ~한'의 최상급 문맥이므로 long을 longest로 변형.
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 정관사 the가 있고 '가장 긴 유년기'라는 뜻이 필요해요. 형용사 long(긴)을 최상급 longest(가장 긴)로 바꿔야 'the longest childhoods(가장 긴 유년기)'가 됩니다. 그래서 정답은 longest.
det.tip: the + 최상급: long → longest. the longest childhoods(가장 긴 유년기)

questions.passage: Spending time as children __________ (allow) animals to learn about their environment. Without childhood, animals must rely more fully on hardware.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어(allow)를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: Spending ... __(allow) animals → 동명사구 주어(Spending time)는 단수 취급이므로 allow를 3인칭 단수 allows로 변형.
det.analysis: 주어가 'Spending time as children(유년기를 보내는 것)'이라는 동명사구예요. 동명사구 주어는 단수로 취급하므로 동사에 -s를 붙여야 해요. 그래서 allow를 allows로 바꿉니다. 정답은 allows.
det.tip: 동명사구 주어 → 단수 동사: allow → allows

questions.passage: Spending time as children allows animals to learn about their environment. Without childhood, animals must __________, and therefore be less flexible. Among migratory bird species, those that are born knowing how, when, and where to migrate — those that are migrating entirely with instructions they were born with — sometimes have very inefficient migration routes. These birds, born knowing how to migrate, don’t adapt easily. So when lakes dry up, forest becomes farmland, or climate change pushes breeding grounds farther north, those birds that are born knowing how to migrate keep flying by the old rules and maps. By comparison, birds with the longest childhoods, and those that migrate with their parents, tend to have the most efficient migration routes. Childhood facilitates the passing on of cultural information, and culture can evolve faster than genes. Childhood gives flexibility in a changing world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 유년기가 없으면 본능(하드웨어)에 더 온전히 의존하게 되어 덜 유연해진다는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① rely more fully on hardware: 원문 일치. 유년기가 없으면 타고난 본능(하드웨어)에 '더 온전히 의존하고' 따라서 덜 유연해진다는 흐름에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② ignore all of their instincts(본능을 모두 무시한다): 오히려 본능에 더 의존한다는 글과 반대
❌ ③ travel without any guidance(아무 지침 없이 이동한다): 본문 근거 없음
❌ ④ forget their whole environment(환경을 모두 잊는다): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: Without childhood, animals must ____, and therefore be less flexible — 본능에 더 의존
